subject: English
passage:
The following text is adapted from Angie Thomas's 2017 novel The Hate U Give. The narrator, who is in high school, is at a local park.

I always sit on this bench to watch the basketball courts. See, there's this group of older guys who come here every afternoon thinking they're gonna dominate the game, but they can barely make it up and down the court without huffing and puffing. And let me tell you, there's nothing more entertaining than watching them try to trash talk while they're completely out of breath. So I hang out here for a while like I'm watching some kind of reality show: The Old Heads Chronicles, featuring wannabe ballers episode one through whatever.

©2017 by Angie Thomas
prompt: Which choice best states the main purpose of the text?

choices.A: To describe an activity that the narrator finds amusing
choices.B: To give a reason why the narrator is considering joining the high school basketball team
choices.C: To explain a conflict that the narrator is trying to resolve
choices.D: To discuss a reality show that the narrator watches on television

explanation:
Choice A is the best answer because it most accurately describes the main purpose of the text. The text describes how the narrator watches older basketball players at a local park. The narrator says that "there's nothing more entertaining" than watching these players struggle while trying to appear confident. Thus, the main purpose of the text is to describe an activity that the narrator finds amusing.

Why B is incorrect:

Choice B is incorrect because the text isn't about the narrator wanting to join a basketball team. The text describes how the narrator finds watching certain basketball players entertaining and makes no mention of the narrator's own athletic aspirations.
